title: Scene Direction
description: Produced by stage 5 (directing). Per-scene cinematographic direction.

visual_medium.description: Copied from the approved brief for downstream prompt-profile routing.

grade.description: Overall grading intent, e.g. 'warm highlights, lifted blacks, soft film grain'.

lensing.description: Optical language. Live-action/hybrid directions use the discrete FOV values defined by seedance-clean rather than equipment or lens model names.

movement_grammar.description: House rules for camera motion, e.g. 'slow push-ins on emotion, static on tension'.

shot_framing.description: The scene's OPENING shot: size, angle, subject placement — e.g. 'medium close-up, eye level, subject frame-left'.

camera_movement.description: The scene's executable shot plan. Animation follows the d-201 cut grammar; live_action/hybrid follows seedance-clean and chooses the least rigid format mode that lands the beat.

format_mode.description: Seedance-clean control mode. Recommended for live_action/hybrid; optional for legacy animation artifacts.

first_frame.description: Visible initial composition, subject positions/orientation/gaze, hand/prop state, and motion from frame one.

location_map.description: Foreground/midground/background, camera position, light origin, and movement paths for this shot.

optics.description: Shot size and FOV in degrees per segment, plus optical character. Live-action values come from seedance-clean's discrete FOV table.

performance.description: Observable acting: muscle movement, eyelines, pauses, breath, listener reactions, and micro-realism.

physics.description: Required mass, inertia, contact, fabric/fluid/particle behavior, and environmental interaction.

white_balance_kelvin.description: Fixed scene white balance when explicitly controlled.

positive_locks.description: Short positive fixers for identity, props, geography, light, wardrobe, and cut continuity.

blocking.description: Who is where, facing which way; respect the 180-degree line.

sound_direction.description: Diegetic sound / ambience intent for this scene.

palette_override.description: Only if this scene deviates from the global palette — say why.

negative_notes.description: Legacy/animation avoidance notes. For seedance-clean these are translated into desired visible states and stored in positive_locks before prompting.

transition_out.description: Directed transition into the next scene — consumed by stage 10.
